intro: The Gadgetzan Water Company posts a bounty on Caliph Scorpidsting, who heads the Wastewander outlaws. Proof of his death goes to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Gadgetzan Water Company of Gadgetzan, Tanaris will pay a high bounty for the head of Caliph Scorpidsting, leader of the Wastewander outlaws. His crimes include:
Bring proof of Caliph Scorpidsting's demise to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle for an immediate reward!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes adventurer, I am an official of the Gadgetzan Water Company. What can I assist you with?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Finally - justice is served! You have struck a mighty blow against those vile nomads! With Scorpidsting's demise, this might be just the thing to finally push those squatters off of Gadgetzan's water wells!
By the authority of the Gadgetzan Water Company, I gladly award you with this bounty. You've done a great service for us all.
